{"consolidated_memory":"**Dropped Frames in realtime/ws/session.ts - Three Separate Incidents**

All three incidents involved frames missing from the client sequence in the websocket session component (realtime/ws/session.ts), but with distinct root causes and triggers:

**Incident 1: [2026-03-06] Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Trigger: Only on first request after cold start
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue
- PR: #2713, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Repro method: Hold a socket open through a network flap
- Measured outcome: Throughput rose 14%, reaching 139 requests per second

**Incident 2: [2026-07-14] Unbounded Retry Loop**
- Trigger: Only when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #7539, branch fix/dropped-frames-6
- Repro method: Hold a socket open through a network flap
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 3.7 s to 343 ms

**Incident 3: [2026-08-29] Config Loader Reading Wrong Environment**
- Trigger: Only for accounts in the 5% rollout bucket
- Root cause: The config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #9974, branch fix/dropped-frames-8
- Repro method: Hold a socket open through a network flap
- Measured outcome: The flaky test went from 89 failures per hundred runs to zero

All work was done on the realtime side, in the same corner of realtime/ws/session.ts."}
